unit.notes:
Sessions follow the LV1 session by its name - needs the Companion Surface driver 0.1.28 or newer in eMotion LV1
A % in a session name follows many LV1 sessions: Tour_% follows Tour_Lisbon, Tour_v2...
Loading a session no longer leaves the previous one's names and settings on unused channels
Autosave can be turned off (SESSIONS)
Restart the engine comes back on the session it was on
Sessions can be exported to and imported from your computer

app.notes:
SETUP - SOFTWARE: the unit and the app side by side, one button to update each, and this window when updates are found
New SNAPSHOTS and SESSIONS tabs
SETUP - LATENCY explains TX LATE and sets the L that fixes it
Restart the engine button in SETUP - UNIT
